# v3.37.0

Covers everything since **v3.36.0**.

This release renames the student import page to **Student Data** and adds an **Export** to it, so student training records can be taken out of the system in the same layout they are imported in. There are no database changes and nothing to run by hand.

## New — export student training records

**Admin › Student Data** now has an **Export** button in its page header, offering **CSV** or **Excel**. It downloads every training record for the company selected in the header switcher (or every company you can see, under **All companies**).

- **Ready to import again.** There is one row per completion. The columns are Full Name, Email Address, Company, Country, Theatre, Cert/Training and Completed Date, which are the import's own field names, so the file maps itself automatically when you import it here or on another system.
- **Reference columns.** Full Title, Training Type and Expiry Date follow, for reading only. The import ignores them.
- **Dates read the same everywhere.** They are written as `yyyy-mm-dd`, which is understood the same way whatever a system's date format setting is.
- **Importing an export back into the same system changes nothing.** Every row is recognised as a duplicate and skipped.

Two things are deliberately left out:

- **OLX completions the system works out itself.** A parent OLX is completed automatically once all its sub-items are held. Only the sub-item rows are exported, and importing them rebuilds the parent. An OLX with no sub-items is an ordinary completion and is included.
- **Students with no training records.** The import needs a training and a completion date on every row, so these could not be imported again.

## Changed — Import is now Student Data

The **Import** page in the Admin menu is now called **Student Data**, because it handles student training data in both directions. Its address has changed from `/admin/import` to `/admin/student-data`. The old address still works and forwards to the new one, so bookmarks keep working. Importing works exactly as before.

## For administrators

- **No database migration.**
- The export is available to the same people as the import: Admins, for the companies they are assigned to. Read-only users cannot use it.

This is a minor release (`3.36.0` → `3.37.0`) because it adds a feature.
